title: Sarbacher put cameras on modified V2 rockets to chase UFOs
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Sarbacher put cameras on modified V2 rockets to chase UFOs, about late 1940s-1950s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Sarbacher's son has now gone on record saying, "My father told me that he used to put cameras on, you know, modified versions of V2 rockets in order to chase UFOs."

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the son of a scientist named Robert Sarbacher has now gone on record about his father's work. According to the son, his father told him he used to put cameras on modified V2 rockets, German rockets from the Second World War, so he could chase UFOs. If true, it would mean the US was actively trying to film these objects in the late 1940s and 1950s.
